prompt: Draft an email to a small bookshop asking whether it could host a reading by three local writers. Mention that the group can provide its own chairs if needed and is flexible about dates. A response of around 120 words is enough.
text:
Subject: Inquiry About Hosting a Local Writers’ Reading

Dear [Bookshop Name/Team],

I’m writing on behalf of three local writers who would love to organize a small reading at your bookshop. We admire the welcoming community you have created and think the event could be a lovely opportunity to introduce readers to new local work.

The format would be simple: short readings from each writer, with time afterward for conversation and book signing if appropriate. We are happy to keep the event modest and can provide our own chairs if that would be helpful. We are also very flexible about dates and timing, and would be glad to work around your existing schedule.

Would you be open to discussing the possibility?

Warmly,  
[Your Name]
